title: Valorant Biometric Stress Dataset Schema
description: Schema for the subject CSV files containing in-game events and physiological data.

player_name.description: Valorant username of the acting subject. May be null for objective events.

victim.description: Valorant username of the affected player. Always 'ME' during a DEATH event.

weapon.description: Internal game engine name of the weapon.

bpm.description: Heart Rate in Beats Per Minute. (0 indicates sensor failure).

rr_ms.description: R-R Interval in milliseconds. (0 indicates sensor failure).

dominant_emotion.description: Primary facial emotion detected by computer vision.

stress_score.description: Psychological stress index derived from facial expressions.

composite_stress.description: Fused stress metric combining face and heart rate.

image_file.description: Relative path to the webcam capture frame.
